name: Heckler
impact: Ahoi attack exploiting interrupts/signals breaks SEV-SNP and TDX
mitigation: Partial: CVE-2024-25744 (int 0x80 gadget) patched via Linux kernel APIC-page check (upstreamed); CVE-2024-25743 (other interrupts) unmitigated for AMD; TDX blocks low-vector interrupts 0-31 by hardware
boundary_statement: Heckler (CVE-2024-25743) is an Ahoi attack exploiting injected interrupts/signals to break AMD SEV-SNP and Intel TDX.

AMD-SEV-SNP.evidence: Page: 'All Intel TDX and AMD SEV-SNP processors are vulnerable to Heckler.'

Intel-TDX.evidence: Page: 'All Intel TDX and AMD SEV-SNP processors are vulnerable to Heckler.' (TDX vulnerable via int 0x80, not via signal injection which TDX hardware blocks.)
